## Summary

What does this pull request change, and why?

## Type of change

- [ ] feat: new feature or content
- [ ] fix: bug fix
- [ ] docs: documentation only
- [ ] style / refactor / perf / chore

## Checklist

- [ ] `bundle exec jekyll build` passes locally
- [ ] Checked affected pages at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or generated files (`_site/`, `.jekyll-cache/`) are included
- [ ] Links, metadata, and image alt text are correct

## Screenshots

Add before and after screenshots for visual changes.
